product.description: This carbon fiber in‑wall speaker is the perfect combination of performance and style. The use of carbon fiber for the woofer means that the speaker can hit harder, go lower, and handle more power with significantly less distortion than conventional drivers. The carbon fiber mid‑range and silk dome tweeter produce clean, crisp, and clear highs and mids. You can fine tune the blend of sound using the built‑in high frequency attenuator in case the sound is too bright. The metal grille can be painted to match your walls and attaches easily using magnets. Louder with Less Power | Higher Power Handling with Less DistortionControl High Frequencies | Easy to Install | Use up to 10AWG Cable8‑inch Carbon Fiber 3‑way In‑Wall Speaker with Magnetic Grille Sound QualityStyleSimplicitySound Quality: Life is too short for speakers that don't sound great!
